column1: # The Messages window's categories, in the order its dropdown lists them:
# the name, the rule groups it shows (the first takes any rule added from
# the window), whether it is the structural one (region ids editable, rules
# added and deleted), and the line shown under the dropdown. Tab separated.

column4: Said when you equip something it has an opinion on, and when your bag is nearly full.
Said on entering a place, and about places it remembers. Region ids are editable and Add location makes a new one.
Said when that boss appears nearby, and at boss kills and kill counts.
Said while it stands clear and watches you fight, and when something big comes near.
Your HP, prayer, poison, venom, skull and run energy.
Small talk while nothing much is happening.
Said near famous quest figures, at moments partway through some quests, and when you finish one.
Each errand has a line for setting off and one for coming back. Go on errands in settings turns them off.
Said now and then while it copies your emotes, spells or teleports, or eats when you eat.
Things that happened before, the outings it was and was not taken on, and how long it has known you.
What time it is where you are, how long you have been playing, and the odd date.
Deaths, drops, thieving, level-ups, being thanked or looked at, and what goes on in the chat.
Said as it takes a thrall's place and when the thrall's time runs out. Mute the thrall in settings silences them.
Hellos, goodbyes, milestones and the rest. To silence them all, add misc to Silence groups or rule ids by name in settings.
